## Exam advice

- If you focus on the "must-learn" items, you should pass the exam.
- For higher grades (90-100%), "edge knowledge" will be required (beyond the must-know items)
- Highlight continuity with previous exams: there will be questions for understanding and explaining.
- A few new question types will cover application, case examples, or code understanding
